channel.title: Uganda - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Uganda, every source cited.

item.title: Jubilee Insurance cleans Kampala streets
item.description: Company staff joined city officials in a cleanup exercise to prevent disease spread and flooding.

item.title: Uganda Tourism Board partners with CAF for AFCON 2027 promotion
item.description: The "Explore Uganda – The Pearl of Africa" brand will feature in tournament promotions to attract visitors.

item.title: Austrian diplomat warns of trust erosion over Uganda court delays
item.description: Dr Katja Kerschbaumer stated that prolonged trials and torture risk undermining public confidence in Uganda's institutions.

item.title: Uganda targets higher coffee export earnings
item.description: A new African Union strategy aims to boost local processing and continental trade for coffee.

item.title: Uganda and EU target €2.2bn for green jobs
item.description: Trade between Uganda and the European Union has surged to €1.8 billion by 2025, with EU investments reaching €2.2 billion.
